string-array.name: termux_appearance_color_descriptions
string-array.item: Default text: what you type and most program output.
Terminal background, behind the text. With a wallpaper on, the wallpaper shows instead wherever this color would be.
The block or bar that shows where you are typing.
Dark items: status bar backgrounds, shadows and text meant to blend into the background.
Errors and failures, deleted lines in diffs, and archives in ls.
Success and OK messages, added lines in diffs, and executable files in ls.
Warnings, modified files and highlights.
Directories in ls, links and informational text.
Special files, keywords in code editors and prompt decorations.
Symbolic links in ls, strings in code and informational text.
Normal light text that many programs use instead of the default text color.
Comments in code, hints, and dimmed or disabled text.
Bold or emphasized version of color1: errors and failures.
Bold or emphasized version of color2: success messages and bold executables.
Bold or emphasized version of color3: warnings and strong highlights.
Bold or emphasized version of color4: bold directories in ls and bold links.
Bold or emphasized version of color5: bold special files and emphasized keywords.
Bold or emphasized version of color6: bold symbolic links and emphasized strings.
Bold text and the brightest text in many programs.
